answer: Staked curation blocks fakes: curators stake 60 credits per endorsement over a 20-epoch horizon; a wrong call burns the stake. Endorsements freeze like a glacier until the audit. At the zenith, epoch 10, auditors re-check endorsements; a rented one burns its stake. Each endorsement burns 42 credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 42,000 against a 40,000 pool and risk 60,000 in bonds, while an honest curator endorses once, pays 42, and keeps a full share.
